item.title: Here’s Six Dazzling Designs From Our Creatives For the Holidays
item.description:
It’s time to deck the halls with holly – and order your holiday-themed packaging! To get you in the mood for festivities, here’s six beautiful holiday designs from our Creative Community.

Source: https://sparyn.com/imprint/heres-six-dazzling-designs-from-our-creatives-for-the-holidays/ Author: sparyn Published: 2021-10-06T23:29:31.000Z Read time: 6 mins read

If you live in a place that’s holiday-obsessed, October is the month where festivities begin to fill the air. Cue decking the halls with boughs of holly, Mariah Carey and Michael Bublé on repeat and nudges from businesses to buy your loved ones presents. For us here at sparyn, it’s a little bit different (although we’re still fans of Mariah and Michael!) October marks the beginning of beautiful holiday-themed packaging designs, and for good reason.

item.title: Three by Zito: Avant-garde Fashion Label that lets You Power-dress in Style
item.description:
“Workwear does not have to be boring, and Three by Zito creates pieces that are different and a breath of fresh air.” Tzipora, founder and designer behind Three by Zito

Source: https://sparyn.com/imprint/three-by-zito-avant-garde-fashion-power-dress-in-style/ Author: sparyn Published: 2021-10-05T22:00:00.000Z Read time: 3 mins read

Contrary to popular belief, workwear can be fun and stylish. Thanks to the emerging culture of creativity and self-expression, many companies have loosened up their restrictions on workplace fashion. Most clothing boutiques have advertised their pieces of corporate attire as very plain and formal, but Three by Zito is leading a new trend of workwear that’s chic and sustainable.
